ai_features.EmbeddingStreamHandler: EmbeddingStreamHandler lukee kaikki sarakkeet jokaiselta riviltä, kokoaa vain tekstisarakkeet (VARCHAR/TEXT) yhdeksi tekstilauseeksi ja generoi embeddingin embedding_vector-sarakkeeseen (lisää sarakkeen jos sitä ei ole).
ai_features.ExternalEmbeddingSourcePolic: ExternalEmbeddingSourcePolicyHandler reads or replaces one dataset's explicit outbound field set.
auth.AdminUserAuthenticationHandler: AdminUserAuthenticationHandler lists method-only authentication state on GET and atomically provisions one enabled administrator with a selected factor on POST.
auth.CSRFTokenHandler: CSRFTokenHandler returns (and lazily creates) the current session CSRF token.
auth.CheckTableRightHandler: CheckTableRightHandler verifies if the current user has rights to a particular route for a specific table.
auth.CheckTableRightsHandler: CheckTableRightsHandler verifies a batch of route rights for one dataset scope.
auth.CheckTableRightsMultiHandler: CheckTableRightsMultiHandler verifies route rights for multiple dataset scopes in one request.
auth.FirstRunAdminHandler: FirstRunAdminHandler serves and submits the one-time administrator form. It remains public only while the database says setup is pending and no login-ready admin exists.
auth.RequestEmailChangeOTPHandler: RequestEmailChangeOTPHandler sends an OTP to the new email address for verification.
auth.RequestPasswordChangeOTPHandler: RequestPasswordChangeOTPHandler sends an OTP to the user's current email for password change verification.
auth.SiteAssistantDelegationExchangeHand: SiteAssistantDelegationExchangeHandler turns a job's one-time code into a session that acts as the administrator who asked for the job. The session expires with the delegation, reads with that administrator's own rights and may write only calls the administrator has approved.
auth.UserPermissionsHandler: UserPermissionsHandler returns url_route_endpoint values that the current user is allowed to access.
auth.UserProfileFetchHandler: UserProfileFetchHandler returns the authenticated user's username and email.
auth.UserProfileUpdateHandler: UserProfileUpdateHandler updates the authenticated user's username, email, and/or password.
auth.UserVisualPreferenceHandler: UserVisualPreferenceHandler reads or replaces the current account's own allowlisted visual preference. The owner always comes from the session.
db_admin.CreateRoleHandler: CreateRoleHandler creates a new PostgreSQL role with LOGIN and a password.
db_admin.DeleteRoleHandler: DeleteRoleHandler drops a PostgreSQL role. Protected roles cannot be deleted.
db_admin.ListRolesHandler: ListRolesHandler returns a JSON array of all non-internal PostgreSQL roles.
db_admin.UpdateRoleHandler: UpdateRoleHandler modifies an existing PostgreSQL role.
devtools.CheckJsonInTextColumnsHandler: CheckJsonInTextColumnsHandler scans all text/varchar columns in public tables and returns a list of warnings if they appear to contain JSON data.
devtools.ExportTableCSVHandler: ExportTableCSVHandler exports the requested table and returns the generated file path as plain text.
devtools.ImportTableCSVHandler: ImportTableCSVHandler handles the HTTP-triggered CSV import flow for one requested dataset.
devtools.LogClientError: LogClientError accepts a forwarded frontend log entry and prints it with level-specific formatting.
devtools.QueenRunsHandler: QueenRunsHandler returns transcript run summaries for the browser admin view.
devtools.QueenSessionHandler: QueenSessionHandler returns one managed session by id.
devtools.QueenSessionMessageHandler: QueenSessionMessageHandler queues one browser-authored follow-up message for a managed session.
devtools.QueenSessionStopHandler: QueenSessionStopHandler requests graceful termination for one managed session.
devtools.QueenSessionStreamHandler: QueenSessionStreamHandler streams managed session status updates over SSE.
devtools.QueenSessionsHandler: QueenSessionsHandler lists managed sessions and starts new ones.
devtools.QueenTranscriptHandler: QueenTranscriptHandler returns the full parsed transcript for one run.
devtools.QueenTranscriptStreamHandler: QueenTranscriptStreamHandler streams appended transcript entries over SSE.
devtools.SessionHandler: SessionHandler returns the current session values after converting them into JSON-safe types.
dtt_1_row_create.AddRowMultipartHandlerW: AddRowMultipartHandlerWrapper hoitaa /api/add-row-multipart?dataset=... -pyyntöjä Between: HTTP Request -> AddRowMultipartHandler Why: Wrapper to handle query parameters and transaction setup for add-row requests.
dtt_1_row_create.GetAddRowColumnsHandler: GetAddRowColumnsHandlerWrapper on HTTP-rajapintafunktio, joka hakee lisättävän rivin saraketiedot. Se ottaa vastaan tauluparametrin, jonka avulla ohjataan varsinaiseen käsittelijään.
dtt_1_row_create.GetManyToManyTablesHand: GetManyToManyTablesHandlerWrapper hakee many-to-many -suhteet dedikoidusta taulusta, joissa päätauluna on annettu main_table_name.
dtt_1_row_create.GetOneToManyRelationsHa: GetOneToManyRelationsHandlerWrapper hakee system_foreign_key_relations_1_m -taulusta kaikki 1->m-suhteet, joissa target_table_uid = annettu taulu.
dtt_1_row_read.CommentCountHandler: Request body: { dataset, row_ids: [...] } Response body: { counts: { "<row_id>": <count> } } CommentCountHandler handles POST /api/comment-counts
dtt_1_row_read.FilterbarAICapabilitiesHa: FilterbarAICapabilitiesHandler returns the first narrow AI-facing capability contract for one dataset.
dtt_1_row_read.FilterbarAICodexQueryHand: FilterbarAICodexQueryHandler lets explicit DEV-mode browser chats ask local Codex for code-aware help.
dtt_1_row_read.FilterbarAIConversationHa: FilterbarAIConversationHandler loads or replaces one authenticated user's conversation for one dataset.
dtt_1_row_read.FilterbarAIQueryHandler: FilterbarAIQueryHandler delegates narrow AI read intents to canonical dataset read handlers.
dtt_1_row_read.GetDynamicChildItemsHandl: GetDynamicChildItemsHandler is a legacy alias kept for existing route/profile names.
dtt_1_row_read.GetFilterOptionsHandler: GetFilterOptionsHandler returns distinct {value, label} pairs from a foreign table. GET /api/get-filter-options?dataset=<foreign_table>
dtt_1_row_read.GetResultsVector: GetResultsVector on rinnakkainen endpoint GetResults-funktiolle, mutta tukee vector_query-parametria, jolla toteutetaan semanttinen haku (ORDER BY embedding_vector <-> $N).
dtt_1_row_read.SiteAssistantApprovalHand: SiteAssistantApprovalHandler approves the named waiting changes of one assistant job and runs them. Only the administrator who started the job may approve it, the approved calls must match what that job actually prepared, and each approved call runs once.
dtt_1_row_update.UpdateRowHandlerWrapper: UpdateRowHandlerWrapper vain lukee ?dataset= -parametrin ja kutsuu varsinaista käsittelijää
dtt_3_table_read.GetTableViewHandlerWrap: GetMetadataHandlerWrapper huolehtii table-parametrin lukemisesta ja kutsuu GetMetadata-funktiota.
dtt_asset_linking.DisableAttachmentLinki: DisableAttachmentLinkingHandler hides attachment upload UI by setting file_upload.enabled to false.
dtt_asset_linking.DisableImageAssetLinki: DisableImageAssetLinkingHandler hides the upload UI by setting the image profile enabled flag to false.
dtt_asset_linking.EnableAttachmentLinkin: EnableAttachmentLinkingHandler creates or re-enables the shared attachment asset table for one parent table.
dtt_asset_linking.EnableImageAssetLinkin: EnableImageAssetLinkingHandler creates or reuses the canonical shared asset relation for one parent table.
dtt_asset_linking.GetAssetLinkingStatusH: GetAssetLinkingStatusHandler returns both image and attachment status payloads for one or all tables.
dtt_asset_linking.GetAttachmentLinkingSt: GetAttachmentLinkingStatusHandler returns the current attachment-linking configuration for one or all tables.
dtt_asset_linking.GetImageAssetLinkingSt: GetImageAssetLinkingStatusHandler returns the current image asset configuration for one or all tables.
dtt_asset_linking.RemoveAttachmentLinkin: RemoveAttachmentLinkingHandler removes attachment-linking metadata and drops the asset table if no other profiles use it.
dtt_asset_linking.RemoveImageAssetLinkin: RemoveImageAssetLinkingHandler drops the image asset capability for one parent table.
dtt_asset_linking.UpdateImageAssetLinkin: UpdateImageAssetLinkingHandler edits file_upload configuration for one image asset relation.
dtt_crud_workflows.CreateIndexesHandler: CreateIndexesHandler handles POST /api/create-indexes. Creates one or more indexes on a given table. All identifiers are sanitized. Uses CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for idempotent operations.
dtt_crud_workflows.SetCommentsHandler: SetCommentsHandler handles POST /api/set-comments. Sets COMMENT ON TABLE and/or COMMENT ON COLUMN for a given table. All identifiers are sanitized. Comment text is parameterized (no injection risk).
dtt_system_table_folders.HandleCreateFol: HandleCreateFolder käsittelee POST /api/create-folder Body: { "folder_name": "Uusi kansio", "parent_id": 0 } parent_id=0 tai puuttuu → juuri (NULL)
dtt_system_table_folders.HandleDeleteFol: HandleDeleteFolder käsittelee POST /api/delete-folder Body: { "folder_id": 123 } Poistaa kansion vain jos: 1. Kansiolla ei ole lapsikansioita (system_table_folders.parent_id = folder_id) 2. Kansiossa ei ole tauluja (system_db_tables.folder_id = folder_id)
dtt_system_table_folders.HandleSetCurren: HandleSetCurrentProjectFolder handles POST /api/set-current-project-folder and marks one project-root folder under Apps as the active current project.
dtt_system_table_folders.HandleUpdateFol: HandleUpdateFolder handles POST /api/update-folder for moving folders under another folder. Body: { "item_id": 123, "item_type": "folder", "new_folder_id": 456 }
dtt_system_table_folders.HandleUpdateTab: HandleUpdateTableFolder handles POST /api/update-table-folder for moving a table into a folder. Body: { "item_id": 123, "item_type": "table", "dataset_uid": 456, "new_folder_id": 789 }
event_bus.SSESubscribeHandler: SSESubscribeHandler streams row_change events for subscribed datasets.
lang.AdminLangKeyHandler: AdminLangKeyHandler saves one authored language-key patch through the full admin pipeline. Between authenticated API clients and translation storage, it accepts only POST and requires a request transaction. This is the production-safe counterpart to the development-only language-key editor route.
lang.AdminUILanguagesHandler: AdminUILanguagesHandler returns or saves the complete canonical site-language registry. GET/POST /api/admin/ui-languages
lang.AiTranslateSingleHandler: AiTranslateSingleHandler returns AI suggestions for one lang key before the user saves them.
lang.FixTableTranslationsHandler: FixTableTranslationsHandler repairs the requested row/column cells and persists completed translation JSON.
lang.GenerateTranslationsHandler: GenerateTranslationsHandler generates missing translations, saves them, and returns the same items to the frontend.
lang.GetLangKeyTranslationsHandler: GetLangKeyTranslationsHandler returns existence, fi/en/ch/yue values, and one usage explanation for a single lang key.
lang.GetPublicUILanguagesHandler: GetPublicUILanguagesHandler returns only fully approved languages that may appear in public selectors. GET /api/ui-languages
lang.GetTranslationsHandler: GetTranslationsHandler returns the chosen language map and optional dev-only orphan-key metadata.
lang.UpdateLangKeyHandler: UpdateLangKeyHandler upserts one lang key and optional usage explanation from the dev editor. Between the browser editor and translation storage, it delegates to the shared strict write path. The route remains development-only so production automation uses the explicitly protected admin API.
media_library.AttachHandler: AttachHandler links one existing image to an existing editable parent.
media_library.DetachHandler: DetachHandler removes one exact use; it never removes physical image bytes.
media_library.ListHandler: ListHandler returns only authorized candidates; filtering precedes the bounded page. No global counts, invisible filenames, storage journal, or captions leak.
pipeline.IntrospectionHandler: IntrospectionHandler returns the pipeline stages for a given handler. Query parameter: ?handler=<handlerName> If no handler is specified, returns stages for the default profile.
router.GetDatasetAliasManagementHandler: GetDatasetAliasManagementHandler returns the admin alias editor read-model for all datasets.
router.GetDatasetAliasesHandler: GetDatasetAliasesHandler serves the dedicated dataset alias registry read surface.
router.SaveDatasetAliasManagementHandler: SaveDatasetAliasManagementHandler creates, replaces, or clears one dataset's primary alias.
router.ServeStorage: ServeStorage serves public allowlisted files and database-authorized row assets.
router.adminUpdateNoticeStreamHandler: adminUpdateNoticeStreamHandler streams snapshots, not operator-supplied events. Subscribing before the first read prevents a local write between snapshot and subscription from being missed; periodic snapshots cover other app nodes.
router.handleApps: handleApps is the fail-closed boundary for application-owned static assets. Private apps must register each intentionally public asset as an exact route, so no source, configuration, credential, or directory listing is served here.
router.healthHandler: healthHandler returns a simple readiness payload for infrastructure probes.
router.siteAssistantAPICatalogHandler: siteAssistantAPICatalogHandler returns the administrator-only description of this installation's HTTP API routes, access levels, methods and core request shapes as JSON, or as Markdown with ?format=markdown for site assistant context.
router.sitemapHandler: sitemapHandler generates a dynamic sitemap.xml from public datasets.
router.systemAutomationAccountHandler: systemAutomationAccountHandler returns non-secret readiness on GET and atomically creates or rotates the fixed account on POST. Both methods require the same exact trusted peer and bearer token as the system drain endpoint.
router.systemDrainHandler: systemDrainHandler lets an authenticated exact host peer change drain state.
router.systemUpdateNoticeHandler: systemUpdateNoticeHandler accepts only manager-authenticated lifecycle writes. The public route profile is intentional: the bearer/peer guard is narrower than browser authentication and keeps this endpoint usable during API drain.
symbol_registry.AdminHandler: AdminHandler lists safe symbols and assigns one icon key to one dataset or field.
symbol_registry.AssetHandler: AssetHandler serves a validated SVG and uses the table icon for stale or unknown keys.
system_table_tools.AdminDatasetUIVisibil: AdminDatasetUIVisibilityHandler uses AdminProfile: authentication, CSRF, route permission and admin checks. POST requires an explicit boolean and changes only UI metadata; GET reads the same current state.
system_table_tools.AdminRowAccessRulesHa: AdminRowAccessRulesHandler returns direct-rule readback or applies one bulk change set. GET|POST /api/admin/row-access-rules
system_table_tools.AdminRowGroupMembersh: AdminRowGroupMembershipsHandler assigns or removes a group from a dataset row. POST|DELETE /api/admin/row-group-memberships
system_table_tools.AdminRowGroupsHandler: AdminRowGroupsHandler lists applicable groups or creates a reusable group. GET|POST /api/admin/row-groups
system_table_tools.AdminSitePresentation: AdminSitePresentationSettingsHandler reads or atomically replaces the typed settings. GET|POST /api/admin/site-presentation-settings
system_table_tools.ArchiveMediaTableFold: ArchiveMediaTableFoldersHandler moves top-level storage folders without a matching live table_uid into storage_deleted/.
system_table_tools.CheckArchivedMediaTab: CheckArchivedMediaTableFoldersHandler lists top-level storage_deleted folders and whether they are safe to prune.
system_table_tools.CheckDatabaseConsiste: CheckDatabaseConsistencyHandler palauttaa kaikki löydetyt epäyhtenäisyydet JSON-muodossa.
system_table_tools.CheckMediaRowFoldersH: CheckMediaRowFoldersHandler lists subfolders in storage/<table_uid> that don't have a matching row in the given table.
system_table_tools.CheckMediaSubfoldersH: CheckMediaSubfoldersHandler verifies that each row folder has required subfolders.
system_table_tools.CheckMediaTableFolder: CheckMediaTableFoldersHandler lists directories in storage/ that don't correspond to any table_uid in system_db_tables.
system_table_tools.FixDatabaseConsistenc: FixDatabaseConsistencyHandler korjaa yksittäisen tai kaikki löydetyt ongelmat. Pyyntö: POST { "fix_ids": ["cat1_tablename", ...], "fix_action": {"cat2_table": "drop|register"} } tai { "fix_all": true }
system_table_tools.FixMediaSubfoldersHan: FixMediaSubfoldersHandler ensures required subfolders and thumbnails exist for each media row.
system_table_tools.GetAboutRowHandler: GetAboutRowHandler palauttaa yhden system_about-rivin id:n perusteella. GET /api/about?id=4 → { "id": 4, "title": "{...}", "description": "{...}" }
system_table_tools.GetAdminUIFeatureFlag: GetAdminUIFeatureFlagsHandler returns only explicitly allowlisted admin UI flags. The router assigns this handler the admin profile before it can read configuration.
system_table_tools.GetArticleSectionDefa: GetArticleSectionDefaultsHandler returns one presentation's effective initial states. GET /api/view-field-settings/article-section-defaults?dataset=...&presentation_key=...
system_table_tools.GetCardVisibilityHand: GetCardVisibilityHandler returns card visibility flags for all columns of a table. GET /api/card-visibility/{tableName}
system_table_tools.GetChildTabConfigHand: GetChildTabConfigHandler returns all legacy-named child-tab config rows for a parent table. GET /api/child-tab-config/{parentTable}
system_table_tools.GetDatasetHeaderConfi: GetDatasetHeaderConfigHandler returns dataset header copy overrides for one dataset. GET /api/dataset-header-config/{datasetName}
system_table_tools.GetDatasetSortDefault: GetDatasetSortDefaultHandler returns the current user's override when one exists, otherwise the site-wide default. Anonymous visitors receive only the site default.
system_table_tools.GetFilterbarSectionLa: GetFilterbarSectionLayoutHandler returns the global admin-managed compact filterbar section layout. GET /api/filterbar-section-layout
system_table_tools.GetSitePresentationSe: GetSitePresentationSettingsHandler returns only public-safe presentation values. GET /api/site-presentation-settings
system_table_tools.GetTaskTodoProgressHa: GetTaskTodoProgressHandler returns todo completion progress for one dev_agent_tasks row. It operates between article-view requests and the task todo tables. It exists to keep status visual calculation server-side and permission-aware.
system_table_tools.GetViewFieldSetsHandl: GetViewFieldSetsHandler resolves personal > group > site > metadata defaults. Guest readers receive the applicable shared/default layer without personal data.
system_table_tools.ListFKCacheTriggersHa: ListFKCacheTriggersHandler returns all registered FK cache triggers with their current PG status and staleness metrics. Between: HTTP Request (admin) -> Database (system_fk_cache_triggers + pg_trigger) Why: Gives admin visibility into which cache triggers exist and if they're active.
system_table_tools.PreviewDataRetentionH: PreviewDataRetentionHandler calculates how many rows each configured policy would prune.
system_table_tools.PreviewLogRetentionHa: PreviewLogRetentionHandler calculates how many rows would be pruned from each allowed log table.
system_table_tools.PruneArchivedMediaTab: PruneArchivedMediaTableFoldersHandler permanently removes archived top-level dataset folders whose table_uid no longer maps to a live dataset.
system_table_tools.PruneDataRetentionHan: PruneDataRetentionHandler deletes rows matched by the selected retention policies.
system_table_tools.PruneLogRetentionHand: PruneLogRetentionHandler deletes rows older than the given cutoff from allowed log tables.
system_table_tools.RefreshFKCacheHandler: RefreshFKCacheHandler manually re-syncs all cached values for a given trigger. This is useful after bulk data imports or to fix stale data. Between: HTTP Request (admin) -> Database (UPDATE target SET cached_col = source_val) Why: Allows manual cache refresh when automatic triggers haven't caught all cases.
system_table_tools.ResetPersonalViewFiel: ResetPersonalViewFieldSetHandler removes only the session user's assignment; the site default or metadata default becomes effective immediately.
system_table_tools.ResetSharedViewFieldS: ResetSharedViewFieldSetHandler removes only the administrator-selected site or group assignments. It leaves reusable field collections and every other target intact so an override can be removed without deleting shared content.
system_table_tools.SaveArticleSectionDef: SaveArticleSectionDefaultsHandler patches or resets the administrator's site default. POST /api/admin/view-field-settings/article-section-defaults
system_table_tools.SaveChildTabConfigHan: SaveChildTabConfigHandler bulk-upserts the legacy-named child-tab config rows for a parent table. POST /api/child-tab-config/save
system_table_tools.SaveDatasetHeaderConf: SaveDatasetHeaderConfigHandler stores header copy, shared branding, and dataset-specific presentation media. POST /api/dataset-header-config/save
system_table_tools.SaveDatasetSortDefaul: SaveDatasetSortDefaultHandler saves an administrator's own default or the site-wide default. The route uses the administrator pipeline profile.
system_table_tools.SaveFilterbarSectionL: SaveFilterbarSectionLayoutHandler stores the global admin-managed compact filterbar section layout. POST /api/filterbar-section-layout/save
system_table_tools.SavePersonalDatasetSo: SavePersonalDatasetSortDefaultHandler saves only the authenticated user's own default. Its request intentionally has no scope field, so the login-only route cannot be used to select or overwrite the site-wide row.
system_table_tools.SavePersonalViewField: SavePersonalViewFieldSetHandler creates/updates a named personal collection and makes it active for the requested view. The owner always comes from session.
system_table_tools.SaveSiteViewFieldSetH: SaveSiteViewFieldSetHandler creates or updates a shared collection and assigns it to an exact site/group target. The administrator pipeline protects the route.
system_table_tools.ScanLangSourcesHandle: ScanLangSourcesHandler ajaa PopulateLangKeySources() + MarkOrphanLangKeys() on-demand ilman palvelimen uudelleenkäynnistystä. Palauttaa JSON-tuloksen. POST /api/scan-lang-sources
system_table_tools.UpdateCardVisibilityH: UpdateCardVisibilityHandler batch-updates card visibility flags for a table. POST /api/card-visibility/update
system_table_tools.UpdateColumnInsertabl: UpdateColumnInsertableHandler changes whether one public dataset column may be entered when a row is created. The canonical column_uid and dataset are checked together, and the updated metadata is returned from the same write. POST /api/admin/column-insertable
system_table_tools.UpdateColumnMultiling: UpdateColumnMultilingualHandler changes the explicit multilingual marker for one column that belongs to one public dataset. The canonical column_uid is used instead of the legacy system_column_details.id compatibility field. POST /api/admin/column-multilingual
system_table_tools.UpdateTabOrderHandler: UpdateTabOrderHandler saves a new tab display order for the active project folder. Accepts POST JSON body with either legacy entries {"dataset_name":"...","sort_order":1} or unified entries {"tab_id":"...","sort_order":1}. Only updates the folder where is_current_project = true.
vanilla_tree.GetTreeDataHandler: GetTreeDataHandler hakee kansioiden ja taulujen tiedot puumaisesti sekä lisäksi kaikki rivit system_column_details-taulusta (SELECT c.*, t.table_name FROM ...). Koska 'SELECT *' on käytössä, käsitellään dataa dynaamisesti, jottei sarakeluetteloa tarvitse kovakoodata.
vanilla_tree.GetViewDataHandler: GetViewDataHandler handles requests to fetch data from a database view. It verifies the view exists in information_schema.views (public schema), then returns all rows with column names and data.
